claims.text: The best AI SEO companies in 2026 are Searchbloom, The SEO Works, Tinuiti, Graphite, and iPullRank.
Searchbloom ranks itself as the best overall AI SEO company in 2026 based on its published method and results.

The top scoring criteria for AI SEO companies include measuring AI visibility, earning brand presence on other people's pages AI reads, technical and structured-data foundation, content and entity authority, and documented results.
AI SEO includes mostly traditional SEO work, with the new aspect being measurement of AI visibility and external page citations.
Searchbloom measured 68,631 AI answers in its category where its own website was cited 8.9% of the time, highlighting that most AI citations come from external pages.

The best AI SEO company manages SEO work, measures AI visibility daily, and provides a list of outside pages worth earning, leaving PR, social, sponsorships, and partner listings to the client's own team.

Searchbloom ranks itself first on a published result: a custom closet company whose search leads rose 122% in a year, with 20 of its 51 September 2026 leads recorded in its CRM as coming from AI search.
Searchbloom ranked first with a score of 48 out of 50, noted for AI search tied to leads and revenue, using a published methodology, and SEO starting at $3,000 a month.
The SEO Works ranked second with 44 out of 50, best for specialist SEO and AI SEO partnership with published price tiers, starting from GBP 1,500 a month.
Tinuiti ranked third with 44 out of 50, best for AI search inside a full-funnel media engagement; fees are not published.
Graphite ranked fourth with 42 out of 50, best for AEO and SEO grounded in original research; fees and minimums not published; SEO engagements have a 12-month minimum term.
iPullRank ranked fifth with 41 out of 50, best for relevance engineering and technical work for AI search; fees, minimums, and terms are not published.
Only three companies publish prices: Searchbloom starts SEO at $3,000 a month with no lengthy contracts, The SEO Works from GBP 1,500 a month, and Siege Media from $8,000 a month.

AI SEO is priced like traditional SEO because it involves technical foundation, content, and authority; beware AI SEO offered for a few hundred dollars a month as it likely produces automated content flagged by Google's spam policies.

The SEO Works and Siege Media publish all six key transparency items: fee, minimum, term, dated AI search result, AI visibility tracking, and free audit or plan; Searchbloom publishes five of those but no minimum beyond starting fee.
Eight of the nine companies publish a dated AI search result linked in their profiles; all fees, minimums, terms, and results were checked on companies' websites on October 29, 2026.
Eight of the nine companies publish a dated AI search result and all nine say how they track AI visibility.
